purpose: Prototype v2 of the works from keystrokes: as v1, with 10 s windows for the figures (30 s kept as a count), the regimes matched to the series from the text in the distribution of gaps (same chance of a rest, same distribution of rest lengths, same mixture of shorter gaps; only the order differs), and the fixes of the reviews of v1.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-31 after seeing the results of v1 (results/prototype_v1, commit 2d033fd and the corrected notes fd7298c): the window width (decision 7 of .steering/20261031-synthetic-prototype, researcher) and the matching of the regimes (decision 5 of .steering/20261031-keystroke-design was not met by v1) are changes made after seeing. No series of v2 had been generated.

keystrokes.unit: press time in ms; no key, character or release

text_timing.source: decision 3 of .steering/20261031-synthetic-prototype: Dhakal et al. 2018 (mean IKI 238.66 ms) and the mixture of Baaijen et al. 2012 cited by Van Waes et al. 2021 (330, 735, 2697 ms); paragraph_end and the sigmas assumed

regimes.matching: src/keystroke.matched_regimes: rest chance = sum over kinds of count x P(gap >= rest_ms); rests drawn at or above rest_ms from the kinds' lognormals weighted by count; short gaps drawn below rest_ms, fast regime = within_word, slow regime = the other kinds weighted by count; mean slow run = mean fast run x slow share / (1 - slow share); run lengths count short gaps only
regimes.presses: per text: the number of presses of the text
regimes.source: mean_run_fast assumed (as v1); the rest matched to the text

windows.windows: src/keystroke.full_windows: half-open [k w, (k + 1) w), the time after the last full window dropped and recorded
windows.speed: median of gaps < rest_ms with both presses in the window (GSE features.rs F1)
windows.rest: share of the window's time inside gaps >= rest_ms
windows.no_speed: p = 0 and flagged; the min-max reference uses only windows with a speed

mapping.form: atact.mapping coefficients: f = F0 + F1 p, s = S0 + S1 q, gamma = G0 + G1 (WP p + WQ q)

external.source: Dhakal et al. 2018, Table 3 (slow and fast typists' mean IKI); decision 5

mapping.minmax: reference only: per series, ln m and rest share each min-max to [0, 1] over its windows, then p and q as above (decision 5)

relief.grey: H / (2 s_max) + 1/2, as the common scale of the works of words (no STL: images only)

figure.rows: per text: from_text, shuffled, regimes (seed index 0 of each), 10 s windows

counts: per series and window width: the share of [0, 1] spanned by the middle half of p and of q over the windows, under the external scale, for every seed and generator (as v1)
